::: {#exr-beech-lead-stove}
@fig-pendulums-state-space-numbered show the state space for the pendulum system. Five points in the state space have been marked. For each, draw a corresponding pendulum picture of the sort shown in `r xf("exr-kid-ring-screen")` (but those pictures are not necessarily answers for this question).
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-pendulums-state-space-numbered
Locations <- tibble::tribble(
  ~ theta, ~ v, ~label, # theta in degrees
  0, -0.5, "A", 
  30, -0.25, "B",
  -30, -0.25, "C", 
  -45, 0.5, "D", 
  60, 0.1, "E"
)
gf_text(v ~ theta, label=~label, data=Locations) |>
  gf_lims(y = .75*c(-1,1)) |>
  gf_labs(y = "velocity", x = (expression(paste(theta, " (deg)")))) |>
  gf_refine(
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-70,70), 
      breaks = c(-60, -45, -30, -15, 0, 15, 30, 60, 45, 60))) |> 
  gf_theme(theme_minimal())
```
:::
